main_text.head: ODE MONOCOLOS. DE STRAGE CLASSIS Hispanicæ.
AD SERENISS. ELIZAB. Angliæ Reginam.
main_text.p: CVM sermo retulit Gentis Ibericæ (Quæ nunc ampla tenet sceptra, quibus ruens Fulcitur Tygridis Romulidæ domus, In pœnas hominum vindice Numine) Turritis pelagus classibus obtegi, Vt pulchræ peterent tecta Britanniæ Christi & Christicolum non grauis hospitis, Dum nunc Christicolæ sedibus à suis Sæua barbarie sunt profugi procul: Mæsta voce DEVM non tepide precans Affabar, geminans votaque votaque. O qui syderei conditor agminis, Tellurisque vagæ rector & arbiter, Et circumreflui qui salis es potens: Isti, qui reliquis Solis in ædibus, Eoa, Occidua, sub Medio die, Iam cunctis requiem gentibus inuident,

page.notes: Short lines are set as verse; the poem is one stanza, so it is one paragraph. Italic is read from the scan: lines "Quæ nunc ... domus," and "Vt pulchræ" to "inuident," look slanted; "In pœnas hominum vindice Numine)" and "Turritis pelagus classibus obtegi," look roman, so their italic status is uncertain. "hospitis" and "Ibericæ" are read from a small, soft print: possible [?] readings. "votaque votaque" is printed as such (repetition kept). The catchword "Arctoa" at lower right is the start of the next page.
